title: E-sports
subtitle: 本課限定語境：e-sports / esports = organized competitive video gaming · 「電子競技／電競」
description: 本課限定語境：e-sports / esports = organized competitive video gaming · 「電子競技／電競」

words.meaning: 競技電子遊戲；競技電玩
words.note: 最直接、清楚地解釋 e-sports 的描述性表達。
words.example: Competitive video gaming has become a major international industry.
words.exampleZh: 競技電子遊戲已成為重要的國際產業。

exercises.original: E-sports has become a major international industry with professional players and global events.
exercises.zh: 電子競技已成為擁有職業選手和全球賽事的重要國際產業。
exercises.upgrade: Competitive video gaming has become a major international industry.

options.explanation: 最直接完整描述 e-sports：電子遊戲＋競技性。
只表示連網玩遊戲，不一定有正式競賽。
強調休閒，與職業賽事相反。

exercises.original: Many universities now offer courses related to e-sports.
exercises.zh: 很多大學現在提供與競技電子遊戲相關的課程。
exercises.upgrade: Many universities now offer courses related to competitive video gaming.

options.explanation: 保留 e-sports 的核心競技性。

exercises.original: E-sports requires training, strategy, communication, and fast decision-making.
exercises.zh: 競技電子遊戲需要訓練、策略、溝通和快速決策。
exercises.upgrade: Competitive video gaming requires training, strategy, communication, and fast decision-making.

options.explanation: 這些能力都指向有系統的競技遊戲。

words.note: 是 e-sports / esports 的完整形式。
words.example: Electronic sports attract millions of viewers worldwide.
words.exampleZh: 電子競技吸引全球數以百萬計觀眾。

exercises.original: E-sports attracts millions of viewers worldwide.
exercises.zh: 電子競技吸引全球數以百萬計觀眾。
exercises.upgrade: Electronic sports attracts millions of viewers worldwide.

options.explanation: 是 e-sports 的完整形式。
指遊戲產品，不一定有競賽。

exercises.original: The growth of e-sports has created new media and sponsorship opportunities.
exercises.zh: 電子競技的增長帶來新的媒體和贊助機會。
exercises.upgrade: The growth of electronic sports has created new media and sponsorship opportunities.

options.explanation: 只是電競媒體的一部分。

exercises.original: Governments in some countries now recognize e-sports as an organized competitive activity.
exercises.zh: 一些國家的政府現在承認電子競技是一種有組織競技活動。
exercises.upgrade: Some governments now recognize electronic sports as an organized competitive activity.

options.explanation: 正式制度語境很適合完整名稱。

words.example: Esports tournaments can fill large arenas.
words.exampleZh: 電競比賽可以坐滿大型場館。

exercises.original: The arena will host an e-sports tournament this weekend.
exercises.zh: 場館本週末會舉辦一場電競錦標賽。
exercises.upgrade: The arena will host an esports tournament this weekend.

options.explanation: 現代最常見的行業／賽事修飾語之一。
太廣，gaming tournament 可以但不一定等於正式 e-sports。

exercises.original: She hopes to work in the e-sports industry after graduation.
exercises.zh: 她希望畢業後在電競產業工作。
exercises.upgrade: She hopes to work in the esports industry after graduation.

exercises.original: The college formed an e-sports team to compete nationally.
exercises.zh: 學院成立電競隊參加全國賽。
exercises.upgrade: The college formed an esports team.

options.explanation: esports team 是自然固定搭配。
gaming team 可理解，但不如 esports 精確。
指比賽／遊戲，不是產業名稱。
單數有時可見，但整體類別通常用 esports。

words.note: 表示以競爭、排名、對賽為核心的遊戲活動。
words.example: Competitive gaming requires strategy, teamwork, and fast reactions.
words.exampleZh: 競技遊戲需要策略、團隊合作和快速反應。

exercises.original: E-sports requires players to compete seriously rather than play only for relaxation.
exercises.zh: 電競要求玩家認真競賽，而不是只為休閒而玩。
exercises.upgrade: Competitive gaming requires players to compete seriously.

options.explanation: 重點是 competition，而非正式產業名稱本身。

exercises.original: Some players begin with informal e-sports before joining professional leagues.
exercises.zh: 一些玩家先參與非正式競技遊戲，之後才加入職業聯賽。
exercises.upgrade: Some players begin with informal competitive gaming.

options.explanation: 可涵蓋未達正式職業 e-sports 層級的競爭活動。

exercises.original: Competitive e-sports can exist even at amateur level.
exercises.zh: 競技遊戲即使在業餘層面也可以存在。
exercises.upgrade: Competitive gaming can exist even at amateur level.

words.note: 更完整地突顯 e-sports 的制度化特徵。
words.example: Organized competitive gaming now includes professional leagues and international events.
words.exampleZh: 有組織的競技遊戲現在包括職業聯賽和國際賽事。

exercises.original: E-sports usually involves structured tournaments, rules, teams, and rankings.
exercises.zh: 電競通常包含有制度的賽事、規則、隊伍和排名。
exercises.upgrade: Organized competitive gaming usually involves tournaments, rules, teams, and rankings.

options.explanation: structured tournaments + rules 正好突出 organized。
也接近，但未必有正式制度。

exercises.original: The federation promotes e-sports through leagues and official competitions.
exercises.zh: 該聯會透過聯賽和正式比賽推廣有組織的競技遊戲。
exercises.upgrade: The federation promotes organized competitive gaming through leagues and official competitions.

options.explanation: federation + leagues + official competitions 是制度化強線索。
未必所有參賽者都是職業。

exercises.original: Schools are increasingly treating e-sports as a structured extracurricular activity.
exercises.zh: 學校愈來愈把電競視為有組織的課外競技活動。
exercises.upgrade: Schools are increasingly treating organized competitive gaming as a structured extracurricular activity.

options.explanation: structured extracurricular activity 對應制度化競賽。

words.note: 指電子遊戲中的正式競賽活動。
words.example: The school hosted a video game competition for students.
words.exampleZh: 學校為學生舉辦了一場電子遊戲競賽。

exercises.original: The school hosted an e-sports event in which students competed in the same game.
exercises.zh: 學校舉辦了一場學生在同一遊戲中競賽的電子遊戲比賽。
exercises.upgrade: The school hosted a video game competition.

options.explanation: 本句聚焦一場具體比賽。

exercises.original: This weekend's e-sports contest will involve sixteen teams.
exercises.zh: 本週末的電子遊戲競賽將有十六支隊伍參與。
exercises.upgrade: This weekend's video game competition will involve sixteen teams.

options.explanation: 指一場具體賽事最直接。
是活動類別，不是單一 event。
可理解但不如標準片語自然。
未必有十六隊正式比賽。

exercises.original: The community centre organized a small e-sports contest for teenagers.
exercises.zh: 社區中心為青少年舉辦了一場小型電子遊戲競賽。
exercises.upgrade: The community centre organized a small video game competition.

options.explanation: league 是長期聯賽，不是一場 contest。

words.note: 表示玩家之間的競技活動。
words.example: The gaming competition attracted teams from ten countries.
words.exampleZh: 這場遊戲競賽吸引來自十個國家的隊伍。

exercises.original: The e-sports competition attracted teams from ten countries.
exercises.zh: 這場遊戲競賽吸引來自十個國家的隊伍。
exercises.upgrade: The gaming competition attracted teams from ten countries.

exercises.original: The university's annual e-sports event includes several different games.
exercises.zh: 大學每年的遊戲競賽包含幾款不同遊戲。
exercises.upgrade: The university's annual gaming competition includes several different games.

options.explanation: 可涵蓋多款遊戲的比賽。
也很接近，但略更描述性。

exercises.original: Several clubs entered the regional e-sports contest.
exercises.zh: 數個俱樂部參加區域遊戲競賽。
exercises.upgrade: Several clubs entered the regional gaming competition.

options.explanation: entered + regional contest 指具體賽事。

words.meaning: 職業電玩；職業競技遊戲
words.note: 當 e-sports 明確涉及職業選手、薪酬、戰隊和聯賽時可接近。
words.example: Professional gaming has created new career paths for young players.
words.exampleZh: 職業電玩為年輕玩家創造了新的職業道路。

exercises.original: E-sports has become a full-time career for some elite players.
exercises.zh: 對一些頂尖選手而言，電競已成為全職職業。
exercises.upgrade: Professional gaming has become a full-time career for some elite players.

options.explanation: full-time career + elite players 是職業化強線索。

exercises.original: Some e-sports players earn salaries from teams and compete in international leagues.
exercises.zh: 一些電競選手從戰隊領薪並參加國際聯賽。
exercises.upgrade: Some players make a career in professional gaming.

options.explanation: salaries + teams + international leagues 明確是職業層面。

exercises.original: The documentary explores how e-sports became a career path for talented young players.
exercises.zh: 紀錄片探討電競如何成為有天分年輕玩家的職業道路。
exercises.upgrade: The documentary explores professional gaming as a career path.

options.explanation: career path 是最直接線索。

falseSynonyms.zh: 打機／遊戲 ≠ 電競 gaming 包含所有玩遊戲活動，包括休閒、單機、社交和競技。
玩電子遊戲 ≠ 電競 只表示玩 video games，不一定有比賽、排名或賽事。
網絡遊戲 ≠ 電競 online 只表示經互聯網進行。 多人網絡遊戲也可以完全沒有 competitive esports 結構。
錦標賽 ≠ e-sports 整體 tournament 是一種賽事形式。 e-sports 是更大的競技活動／產業。
直播 ≠ 電競 很多 e-sports 會直播，但直播也可用於一般遊戲、聊天或其他內容。
遊戲開發 ≠ 電競 game development 是製作遊戲； e-sports 是競賽遊戲。
形式差異 現代一般用 esports 作行業／活動名稱。 esport 單數有時可見於特定語境，但整體概念通常寫 esports。
詞形陷阱 - compete = 動詞 - competition = 名詞 - competitive = 形容詞
